visual_elements.description: Small 3-row, 2-column parameter table. Row 1: 'step' | '0.4'. Row 2: 'initial X' | '3'. Row 3: 'delta' | '0.1'. Left-column cells have colored backgrounds (green, red, yellow).

2D Cartesian plot of f(x)=(x-5)^2+1. Blue upward parabola with vertex at (5,1). X-axis ticks at -6, 0, 5, 10, 15. Y-axis ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15. Light gray grid lines. Red vertical dashed line at x=5. Red dot at (2,10) labeled '(2,10)' in red. Green dot at (5,1) labeled '(5,1)' in green. Horizontal black line at y=10 extending from x=2 rightward to approximately x=7.

Large 8-row, 7-column gradient descent table. Column 1 contains row labels with colored backgrounds; columns 2-7 contain iteration data. Row 1 'x' (light green): 3, 3.4, 3.8, 4.2, 4.6, 5. Row 2 'f(x)' (light yellow): 5, 3.56, 2.44, 1.64, 1.16, 1. Row 3 'x-delta' (light green): 2.9, 3.3, 3.7, 4.1, 4.5, 4.9. Row 4 'f(x-delta)' (light yellow): 5.41, 3.89, 2.69, 1.81, 1.25, 1.01. Row 5 'x+delta' (light green): 3.1, 3.5, 3.9, 4.3, 4.7, 5.1. Row 6 'f(x+delta)' (light yellow): 4.61, 3.25, 2.21, 1.49, 1.09, 1.01. Row 7 'slope' (light red): -8, -6.4, -4.8, -3.2, -1.6, 0. Row 8 'next x' (light red): 3.4, 3.8, 4.2, 4.6, 5, stop.
Pink/magenta arrow pointing from the 'Reach Minimum after 6 Steps' text downward to the top edge of the iteration table.
Yellow filled circle with black outline containing the number 32.
Small solid red dot, likely a mouse cursor or laser pointer marker.

imagery: No photographs or illustrations. Only geometric shapes, tables, a function plot, and text.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large and bold with three color segments (dark red, green, blue). Body text is black and medium-sized. Table text is small. 'X = 5' is bold red. '1.0' is bold blue. 'Minimum value is' and 'Reach Minimum after 6 Steps' are purple/magenta. Row labels in tables are bold. The number 32 is bold black inside a yellow circle.
animation_state: None. All elements appear fully revealed; no partial builds or missing bullets.
recreation_brief: 1) Set slide background to light gray #F0F0F0. 2) Add a left-aligned title text box at the top: type 'Convex Function, ' in bold dark red #C00000, then 'Learning Rate =0.4, ' in bold green #008000, then 'Start at X=3' in bold blue #0000FF; use ~30pt sans-serif. 3) Add a yellow #FFFF00 circle at the top-right corner with a black outline and bold black text '32' (~20pt). 4) Add a small 3x2 table at top-left: cell(1,1)='step' with light green #C0E0C0 fill, cell(1,2)='0.4'; cell(2,1)='initial X' with light red #F0C0C0 fill, cell(2,2)='3'; cell(3,1)='delta' with light yellow #FFFFC0 fill, cell(3,2)='0.1'; give it a thin dark border. 5) Insert a scatter/line plot at top-right: set x-axis from -6 to 15 with ticks at -6,0,5,10,15 and y-axis from 0 to 15 with ticks at 0,5,10,15; plot the blue #0000FF parabola f(x)=(x-5)^2+1; add a red #FF0000 vertical dashed line at x=5; add a red #FF0000 dot at (2,10) with red label '(2,10)'; add a green #008000 dot at (5,1) with green label '(5,1)'; add a black horizontal line at y=10 from x=2 to x=7; use light gray gridlines. 6) Add a text box center-left with the equation 'f(x)=(x-5)²+1' in black (~20pt). 7) Below it add 'X = 5' in bold red #C00000. 8) Below that add 'f(x) ' in black, 'Minimum value is ' in purple #800080, and '1.0' in bold blue #0000FF. 9) Below that add 'Reach Minimum after 6 Steps' in purple #800080. 10) Draw a pink #C000C0 arrow from the 'Reach Minimum' text pointing down-right to the iteration table. 11) Add a large 8x7 table at the bottom: first column holds row labels with fills (x=light green, f(x)=light yellow, x-delta=light green, f(x-delta)=light yellow, x+delta=light green, f(x+delta)=light yellow, slope=light red, next x=light red); fill data cells white; set outer border blue #0000FF and inner borders thin black/colored; enter all numeric values exactly as listed in the table description, ending with 'stop' in the last cell.
